name: Thor (Jane Foster)

abilityDetails.Stagger: Sendeletilen (Staggered) şampiyonlar bir sonraki kazandıkları buff'ı Nullify eder.
abilityDetails.Shock: Zamanla elektrik tabanlı şok hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Fervor: Giden hasar veren etkilerin yetenek doğruluğunu artırır.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Wither: Rakibin güç kazanma ve iyileşme etkilerini zayıflatır.

signatureAbility:
When Thor activates a Special Attack, she Nullifies one Power Gain or Fury Buff on the Opponent.
While Thor is suffering from 7+ Shock effects, the Opponent is inflicted with a [44 - 80]% Wither Passive.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Thor's energy is focused on herself. The potency of the Mystic Dispersion Mastery is reduced by 50%.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attack
content: Charging a Heavy Attack after landing a Non-Combo Ending attack inflicts a Stun Passive for .75 seconds.
If the Opponent is Stunned, Thor's Heavy Attack gains +[687.5] Critical Rating for each personal Shock effect on her.
When Thor strikes the Opponent with a Heavy Attack, she inflicts 2 Stagger Passives for 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Shockingly Mighty
content: All of Thor's Basic Attacks have a 40% chance to inflict her with a Shock Passive that deals no damage and lasts 15 seconds. Max stacks: 15.
When Thor Nullifies a Buff, she inflicts herself with one of these Shocks.
Thor gains +[1,385.41] Attack Rating for each Shock effect she is suffering from, up to 25.
Whenever a Stagger effect on the Opponent expires, or a Buff on them is Nullified, Thor pauses her personal Shock Passives for 5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation, gain a 65% Fervor Passive for 20 seconds. Max stacks: 2.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: For each personal Shock on Thor, the final hit inflicts Shock Debuff [5,328.5] Energy Damage over 2 seconds. Then, consume all of Thor's personal Shock Passives.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Thor gains a Power Gain Passive granting 50 of Max Power over 15 seconds.
While this Power Gain is active, Thor gains 60% Critical Rating.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability -That Which Smashes
content: When Thor activates a Special Attack, she Nullifies one Power Gain or Fury Buff on the Opponent.
While Thor is suffering from 7+ Shock effects, the Opponent is inflicted with a [44 - 80]% Wither Passive.
